statements.impact_statement: The advisory is informational: Astral ended maintenance of `astral-tokio-tar` on 2026-11-03 and no version is patched. Its one carrier is `testcontainers` 0.28.0, which `ferrobridge-testkit`, the test-support crate (`publish = false`), uses to start the PostgreSQL server and the reference CDR the end-to-end tests run against. Every workspace root above reaches it only through a dev-dependency on `ferrobridge-testkit` or on `testcontainers`, so the crate is in none of the products. `cargo tree -p ferrobridge-server` and `cargo tree -p ferrobridge-console` over normal and build edges, all features and all targets, find no `astral-tokio-tar` node (`ferrobridge-server` takes `testcontainers` as a dev-dependency only), and the server binary, the `ferrobridge` image and the `ferrobridge-console` image are built from exactly those graphs. No release of `testcontainers` leaves the crate (0.28.0 requires ^0.6.1 and the upstream main branch requires 0.7.0). Re-evaluate when a `testcontainers` release drops the dependency, or if `ferrobridge-testkit` ever becomes a normal dependency of a shipped crate.
